purpose.en: Resolve the responsible cause completely within the approved objective.
purpose.zh: 在已批准目标内完整解决根因。

entry.zh: 存在可定位的失败阶段

exit.en: The cause and affected consumers are corrected with engineering coverage.
exit.zh: 根因与受影响使用方已修正，并有工程覆盖。

failure.en: Escalate only changed scope, published obligations or unauthorized effects.
failure.zh: 只提交范围、已发布义务或未获授权影响的变化供决策。

boundary.en: Do not accumulate local workarounds or development compatibility versions.
boundary.zh: 不积累局部补丁链或开发过程兼容版本。
